# Copilot instructions — SANKET / Prisma

**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root and follow it. It is
authoritative and applies to you.**

It defines, in full:

- **The Iron Law** — check for an applicable workflow before acting, announce
  which one you are following, then follow it. Simple, urgent, and small tasks
  are not exceptions.
- **The workflows** — brainstorming and written plans before non-trivial
  changes; strict RED → GREEN → REFACTOR test-driven development; root-cause
  investigation before any bug fix; verification before claiming completion.
- **Project rules** — PostgreSQL row-level security is never bypassed in
  application code, no live payment keys, icons only via
  `frontend/src/components/ui/icons.tsx`, and no synthetic data standing in for
  a real signal.

You cannot invoke Claude Code skills. That does not exempt you: follow the
workflows in AGENTS.md §3 manually, and say which one you are following.
